digest.component_or_area: Makefile lint scope and ruff configuration (scripts/)
propositions: scripts/ (41 files, 79 ruff check violations including 50 T201) is excluded from all lint gates because Makefile sources excludes it, creating ungated CI-invoked gate implementations
Pre-existing substantive violations (28 total: RUF100×12, E501×11, RUF005×2, RUF059×2, B905×1, RUF036×1) must be fixed before adding scripts to Makefile sources

Consolidating T201 exemption from nine per-file single-file entries into one scripts/** entry creates 28 redundant inline # noqa: T201 directives that become new RUF100 violations, requiring both steps in same change
Seven formatter-nonconforming scripts files must be reformatted before scripts is added to sources, or ruff format --check will fail in CI
Five RUF100 directives reference disabled rules (PLC0415, S603, S310, PLR0915) with documented intent that must be preserved as plain comments rather than deleted

No behavior change is required in the seven CI-invoked gate scripts (check_verify_gate_parity, check_comment_hygiene, check_raw_git_writes, check_wall_clock_asserts, gen_env_registry, check_docs_index, check_readme_quickstart)
